jobs.title: AI Strategist - US United States Apply
jobs.description: Factify Website Book a Demo Careers / AI Strategist - US United States · Sales · Senior · Full-time AI Strategist - US Apply Description About us We are building the Governed Truth Infrastructure that makes agentic AI safe for highly regulated industries like banking and insurance. Powered by our proprietary "Seal, Enforce, Prove" architecture and backed by a growing patent portfolio, our platform is already live in production with enterprise partners driving real ARR. We designed this infrastructure specifically for the builders on the front lines: developers, AI strategists, and Forward-Deployed Engineers (FDEs). With FDEs now the fastest-growing role in tech - up over 700% year-over-year - these teams need a secure, reliable foundation to govern AI agents performing high-stakes work. That’s exactly what we provide: a platform they can trust. We're well-funded ($73M raised), the team is strong, and there's real momentum in the market. This isn't a bet on "maybe it'll happen" - it's already happening. ﻿ The Role The Applied AI Strategist helps customers turn complex business needs into practical AI solutions. This role combines business understanding, applied AI fluency, product thinking, and strong execution. You will work closely with customers and internal teams to understand problems, define solutions, guide implementation, and ensure the resulting systems deliver measurable value. You will bring structure to ambiguous challenges, make thoughtful trade-offs, and help move AI initiatives from concept to reliable production use. What You'll do Develop a deep understanding of customer workflows, requirements, constraints, and goals. Identify and prioritize high-value opportunities for applying AI. Translate ambiguous business needs into clear solution plans, requirements, and success criteria. Design and validate solution concepts through prototypes, demonstrations, and structured evaluations. Define prompt, context, workflow, and evaluation approaches for AI-powered solutions. Coordinate stakeholders and maintain alignment throughout implementation. Guide trade-offs across speed, quality, reliability, scalability, governance, and customer impact. Identify and resolve risks or blockers that could affect successful delivery. Measure solution performance, adoption, and business value. Turn recurring customer needs and implementation lessons into reusable capabilities and best practices. Requirements 5+ years in product management, solutions engineering, technical consulting, technical program management, or another customer-facing technical role. Experience taking complex software, data, machine-learning, or AI initiatives from concept through production and adoption. Strong applied AI fluency, including familiarity with LLMs, agents, retrieval, tool use, prompt and context engineering, evaluations, and human-in-the-loop workflows. A first-principles approach to turning ambiguous problems into practical, applicable solutions. Strong product and systems judgment. The ability to connect technical decisions to customer and business outcomes. Excellent communication skills across technical and non-technical audiences. High ownership, attention to detail, and follow-through. Comfort operating in a fast-moving environment with evolving priorities. Excellent written and spoken English. ﻿Strong Advantages Experience using Python, SQL, APIs, or modern AI tools to prototype and validate ideas. Experience with workflow automation and orchestration tools (e.g., UiPath, n8n, Make, Power Automate, or Zapier) Experience in financial services, insurance, or another regulated industry. Familiarity with policy, compliance, risk, or other rules-driven workflows. Experience working with enterprise requirements such as security, privacy, data governance, and system integrations. A degree in computer science, data science, engineering, or another relevant technical or quantitative field, or equivalent hands-on experience. Contact Details

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer Tel Aviv, Israel Apply
jobs.description: Factify Website Book a Demo Careers / Senior Product Designer Tel Aviv, Israel · Product Management · Senior · Full-time Senior Product Designer Apply Description About Factify ﻿ We are building the Governed Truth Infrastructure that makes agentic AI safe for highly regulated industries like banking and insurance. Powered by our proprietary "Seal, Enforce, Prove" architecture and backed by a growing patent portfolio, our platform is already live in production with enterprise partners driving real ARR. We designed this infrastructure specifically for the builders on the front lines: developers, AI strategists, and Forward-Deployed Engineers (FDEs). With FDEs now the fastest-growing role in tech - up over 700% year-over-year - these teams need a secure, reliable foundation to govern AI agents performing high-stakes work. That’s exactly what we provide: a platform they can trust. We're well-funded ($73M raised), the team is strong, and there's real momentum in the market. This isn't a bet on "maybe it'll happen" - it's already happening. ﻿ The role This is a crucial role on a small, senior team. You own your work end to end: UX & UI in one person. No one handing you specs, no layers between you and the product or engineering. You'll work directly with our VP of Product on a product that doesn't yet have a design playbook. That last part is the real job. We're designing a category that doesn't exist. Surfaces where both people and AI agents consume the same information. Interfaces for multiple types of personas - technical teams who live in APIs and business owners who care about business output. Views that shift by role and permission. Nobody has good patterns for this. You'll invent them. What you'll do Own product design end to end, from core experiences to the details nobody else notices. Take an abstract, ambiguous problem and turn it into something people trust on sight. Design for two users at once: the human making a decision and the agent doing the work. Make governance, provenance, and permissions feel like clarity, not compliance overhead. Shape the brand and make Factify feel like nothing else in the category. Requirements A full-stack product designer. Strong UX, strong UI, real brand instinct. Not great at one and thin on the rest. AI-first mindset. You feel at home working hands-on with AI tools and operating agents on your behalf. You will not be able to keep up with the team without that. Product thinking under ambiguity. You can take a vague, hard problem, decide what to build and what to leave out, and defend the cut. Craft. You care about the pixel, the microinteraction, the moment something clicks. Delight isn't decoration to you. It's how trust gets built. Comfort with technical and infrastructure products. You don't need to write code, but APIs, developers, and a problem with no consumer analog don't scare you. A point of view. You argue from the user and the problem, not from taste, and you'll change your mind for a good reason without folding. Start-up mode on. We run faster than market changes. You need to feel comfortable in an ever-changing environment, where we are stubborn on our vision but flexible on the details. Contact Details
